description: Build a Control Variables (122) event command for insertion via insert_event_commands. Applies operation (set/add/sub/mul/div/mod) to a variable (or the inclusive variableId..endId range) using an operand: constant, another variable, a random range, or game_data (item/actor/party/… readouts). Read-only: returns { command }.

endId.description: Inclusive range end (default = variableId, a single variable)

operand.description: The right-hand operand of the Control Variables command

dataType.description: game_data: 0 item/1 weapon/2 armor count, 3 actor, 4 enemy, 5 char, 6 party, 7 other, 8 last

type.description: Operand source for the variable value

operation.description: Arithmetic applied to the target (default set)

name: build_control_variable
